notes.title: New title drop!
notes.content:
The team behind WET VR have just dropped another title: HIT!Check it out and grab the limited-time launch sale!

What is HIT?

It's the ultimate stress-buster! Take out your stress by pummelling, slapping, and whacking squishy clay heads. Thanks to the wild soft body physics, every hit deforms and reshapes the heads in hilariously unpredictable ways!



⭐ Over 1,800 5-star reviews on the Quest store(!), this is what people are saying:



"Fun game to get your anger out no bugs just fun..." - Meta Quest store review

"W game - This games amazing! Also I love how they say different voice lines" - Meta Quest store review

"Great game - I had a lot of fun playing this game but I hit my hand on the wall" - Meta Quest store review



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555410/HIT/"][/dynamiclink]

Happy hitting! 👊
